claims.claim_text: The indexed Dilworth C. Brinton is confirmed as the Army entrant represented by the exact-name and private-identifier match in the official merged file.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The full name and private service identifier match across the OSS index and official Army-entry file; the identifier is withheld.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Confirmed by an exact private identifier and exact normalized full name.
claims.temporal_assessment: The Army-entry record is dated May 19, 1943; the index documents an OSS personnel file but not the OSS transfer date.
claims.match_notes: The official merged file supplies one exact private-identifier and full-name match. Later Mesa namesakes and family references were not used to extend the wartime claim.
